stories.headline: Valve warns Steam Machine prices may rise as 2TB supply tightens
stories.summary: Valve says sharply rising memory and storage costs are making Steam Machine production more expensive and less predictable. The 512GB model is currently available after existing reservations were fulfilled, but Valve has closed the 2TB waitlist and cannot yet confirm future stock levels or pricing.

stories.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI adds GTA+ perks to its single-player campaign
stories.summary: PC Gamer reports that Rockstar's $7.99 monthly GTA+ subscription now offers benefits inside Grand Theft Auto VI's single-player mode, including an exclusive car and garage, free public transport and rentals, and discounts on in-game purchases. Players who preordered receive one free month. The game remains console-only, with no announced PC release date.

stories.headline: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria returns to PC on Steam today
stories.summary: SNEG plans to release the 2003 fantasy strategy game on Steam on November 20. The updated edition adds support for modern resolutions including 4K, borderless widescreen play, community patch improvements, the fan-made Amthor campaign, Steam achievements and cloud saves. Its ten factions and tactical one-on-one battles remain intact.

stories.headline: Rock Band Simulator targets November 20 launch on Steam
stories.summary: PlayWay and KONTRĀST MEDIA's first-person music life sim is scheduled to release on PC today. Set in a rough 1990s neighbourhood, it mixes rhythm-based concerts and band management with odd jobs, gear upgrades, and tough choices over seven in-game days. A free demo is already available on Steam.

stories.headline: Network & Cyber Security Simulator prepares its PC Early Access debut
stories.summary: The first-person networking and cybersecurity sim is scheduled to begin Steam Early Access on November 20. Players can connect physical network equipment, configure VLANs, SSH and NAT through a simulated terminal, investigate security alerts, and practise defending against SQL injection and cross-site scripting. A demo is available before launch.

stories.headline: Mark of the Deep is free to keep on Epic Games Store until November 26
stories.summary: Epic's PC storefront lists Mad Mimic's pirate-themed action adventure at 100% off through November 26 at 17:00. The game mixes Metroidvania-style exploration with Souls-like combat as players search a cursed island for their missing crew. The giveaway applies to the Epic Games Store edition, not the separate Steam listing.

stories.headline: GTA 6 first-day sales estimated at 24.58 million copies
stories.summary: Market-intelligence firm Sensor Tower estimates Grand Theft Auto VI sold 24.58 million copies in its first day, generating about $2.36 billion worldwide. It estimates roughly three-quarters of sales were on PlayStation 5. These are third-party estimates, not confirmed figures: Rockstar and Take-Two have not announced official first-day totals.

stories.headline: Black Mesa gets Steam Deck Verified status in major overhaul
stories.summary: Crowbar Collective's Anomalous Improvements Update brings Steam Deck Verified status and much better out-of-the-box controller support to the Half-Life remake. It also overhauls the interface, improves engine performance and mod support, and upgrades lighting and interior reflections. The developer's Xen comparison shows frame rates rising from roughly 130 to 170 fps in one scene.

stories.headline: Soldiers at War heads to Steam for the first time on November 20
stories.summary: SNEG's Steam release of the 1998 World War II turn-based tactics game is scheduled for November 20. Players lead an eight-soldier squad through 18 linked missions, including D-Day and Monte Cassino. This PC re-release adds modern Windows compatibility, widescreen support, Steam achievements and cloud saves.

stories.headline: Theocracy returns on Steam with modern Windows support and FSR scaling
stories.summary: SNEG is bringing Philos Laboratories' 2000 strategy game to Steam on November 20. Set in 15th-century Mexico, it combines real-time strategy, city building and empire management as players try to unite Aztec tribes before the Spanish invasion. The updated PC edition retains its original 800x600 resolution but adds FSR 1 scaling, Steam achievements and cloud saves.

stories.headline: Crusader Kings III is free to play this weekend and 70% off
stories.summary: Paradox's medieval grand-strategy game is free to play on Steam until November 23 at 19:00. The base game is also 70% off until November 30; the recently released Silk & Silver expansion is sold separately. Free-weekend access ends when the trial closes unless the player purchases the game.

stories.headline: Myth of Empires: Throne Season 4 launches with flying mounts
stories.summary: Realm of Soaring Skies began November 20 at 15:00, opening the 64 km² Voidbound Realm map with floating islands, tameable Mystic Crane and Wildfire Phoenix mounts, and the Northern Azure Kun platform that supports building in flight. The free-to-play seasonal sandbox also adds Sect Challenges, individual leaderboards, and new rewards.

stories.headline: Death Stranding Collection pairs both games in a new Steam bundle
stories.summary: Kojima Productions has introduced a limited-time Steam bundle combining DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT and DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH for the Black Friday period. Steam applies a bundle discount, and players who already own one title can complete the set without buying it again. The publisher has not specified an end date.
